group:paper-mock-shandong-zibo-2026-05-s.overview: 文章谈大学校园安全：学校靠紧急电话、巡逻和警报等措施保障安全，学生普遍感到放心；但设备之外还要靠学生互相照应，很低的事故率证明两方结合有效，校园安全要靠共同努力。
group:paper-mock-shandong-zibo-2026-05-s.fullTranslationZh:
无论白天还是夜晚，走在大学校园里，学生们都能轻易看到遍布各个功能区、闪着蓝光的紧急求助电话。这些设备能迅速把使用者接通到紧急救助。各高校还提供专业的安保巡逻和实时警报。高校采取多种切实可行的安全措施，为校园里的师生筑起一道可靠的安全屏障。
大多数低年级学生说，他们在校园里时时刻刻都能感到强烈的安全感。他们提到，如果在去教室和宿舍楼的路上遇到突发危险或意外麻烦，马上就能得到及时的帮助。规范的校园布局和完善的配套安全设施大大减少了学生对日常人身安全的担忧。学生们普遍对校园现有的安全安排感到放心。
然而，仅靠学校配置的安全设备，无法实现全天候的全面保护。学生的主动作为和相互关照大大增强了校园的整体防护。许多学生会好心提醒同伴，深夜返回时避开僻静、昏暗、少有人走的小路。课后户外活动时，他们互相照应；天黑以后，他们选择结伴而行，不独自走路。
校园安全记录证明了多方共同预防的成效。校园安全风险一直保持在很低的水平。人身安全事故和公共财产损失在校园里全年都很少发生。这些数据进一步表明，学校管理与学生自身的警惕相结合，效果非常好。
总之，校园安全要靠共同努力。院校和个人的积极参与能够实现长久的安全。只有密切合作，人们才能让校园保持稳定、有序、安全，让大家安心学习、平静生活。

completedSourceTexts.text: Walking around university campuses day and night, students can easily see glowing blue emergency phones spread over every functional area. These devices can quickly connect users to emergency help. Professional security patrols and real-time alerts are also provided by colleges. Universities carry out various practical safety measures to build a reliable safety barrier for teachers and students on campus.

Most young students in lower grades say they can feel a strong sense of safety on campus all the time. They mention that they can get timely help right away if they run into sudden risks or unexpected troubles on the way to classrooms and dorm buildings. Standard campus layout and complete supporting safety facilities greatly reduce students’ worries about daily personal safety. Students generally feel secure with current safety arrangements on campus:

However, safety equipment arranged by schools alone cannot achieve full protection around the clock. Student initiative and mutual care significantly enhance overall campus protection. Many students will kindly remind their peers to avoid quiet, dimly-lit lonely paths when walking back late at night. They look out for one another during after-school outdoor activities and choose to move in groups instead of walking alone after dark.

Campus safety records demonstrate the success of combined preventive efforts. Campus safety risks have stayed at a very low level. Personal safety accidents and public property loss rarely take place on campus all year round. The data further indicates that the combination of school management and student caution is highly effective.

In a word, campus safety relies on joint efforts. Active participation from institutions and individuals can achieve long-term security. Only with close cooperation can people keep the campus stable, orderly and safe for daily study and peaceful-life.
